title: Not for toast but okay for oven
text: Not for toast but okay for oven. using it now for several months - first toast was great - hasn't cooked it evenly since.  We will probably just go back to a regular toaster after this one dies.

product_metadata.title: Proctor Silex 31111 Toaster Oven/Broiler, Black
features: Handy broiler for cooking versatility and drop-down crumb tray for easy cleanup
Handy broiler for cooking versatility and drop-down crumb tray for easy cleanup
description: Great for everyday meals or as a second oven for the holidays , the Hamilton Beach 4 Slice Toaster Oven easily fits 4 slices of bread. It includes a bake pand and has bake, broil and toast settings.
